text: Fun way to work on your tasks. text: I really like this todo rpg app. It os possible to set habits, tasks and goals with milestones. This really comes in handy for the normal todo's and projects. There is one thing that I would like to have as an option: at the today tab it would be great if one could choose to display overdue tasks/milestones as well. I'm using the today tab a lot as my daily todo list and currently I have to switch to the task tab manually to see overdue tasks (which I tend to forget, making them more overdue)
